summary: One POST form (login_form) on the organisation's own origin at /login/ and /accounts/login/, shown when the organisation allows password sign-in. The project publishes the template with the controls written out.

sources.title: Zulip Server 12.3 URL routes: the template is served on accounts/login/ and login/

selectors.note: The type attribute is text or email depending on a server setting, so the selector does not rely on it.

staysInteractive.note: External methods (SAML, OIDC, social) are separate buttons below the form. An organisation with password sign-in turned off shows no form at all, and the login then stops as a layout mismatch.
A server with the two-factor wizard enabled shows a token step after the password. Its fields are rendered by the wizard at run time and are not pinned here.

schemaGaps: The path gate names paths at the host root, and the format has no installation-relative gate. An installation under a sub-path is not covered. Nothing is filled there.
notes: The same form id, field ids, field names and submit button are in the template of releases 5.0, 8.0 and 10.0 (read at those tags on 2026-10-12). Releases older than 5.0 were not read. LDAP sign-in uses this same form. The form posts to /accounts/login/, where a failed sign-in shows it again.
